output.headline: Nordic Capital can add this $200M Midwest Healthcare Services target to an open platform, backed by four core deals, a 2024 Midwest deal and Fund XI.
output.differentiator: Welsh Carson and Advent also have open platforms. Nordic's edge is its own Healthcare Services record: two Core LBOs of $991M and $1,304M, a 2024 Midwest recapitalization, and Fund XI capital [D:MA-2023-0466, D:MA-2022-0045, D:MA-2024-0431, P:2]. It is also a provider specialist with an open platform in the sub-sector [A:angles].

acquirer_overview.title: Nordic Capital is an active, high-closing provider sponsor with Fund XI capital
acquirer_overview.body: Nordic is a financial sponsor with 24 deals from 2016 to 2024, and 21 of 24 (88%) closed [T:record, K:closed_share]. 22 of 24 deals are provider deals, and 22 of 24 (92%) were control deals [A:angles, K:control_share]. Physician Groups is its largest sub-sector with 10 deals, and Healthcare Services has 4 [K:by_sub_sector]. Healthcare is one of four core industries [P:1]. Fund XI closed at its EUR 9 billion hard cap (about $11 billion) [P:2]. It has done 9 deals since 2022 [K:recent]. Its closest ring to the target is Core [B:buyer].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: The target fits an existing Nordic platform in its own sub-sector, with a Midwest foothold
strategic_fit_thesis.body: Nordic has an open platform in the sub-sector, so the target can come in as an add-on [A:angles]. Deals in this or neighbouring sub-sectors raise its likelihood by x1.30, the strongest signal [S:sector_rel]. It has 4 core deals and 18 Ring 1 deals, which share the target's business model [T:record]. The 2024 Principal Physician Group recapitalization, at $76M, was in the Midwest [D:MA-2024-0431]. The target's 16.8% margin and 11.0% growth suit a buyer that paid a median 12.5x EBITDA [X:target, T:record]. It ranks position 2 in Tier 1 [R:rank].

precedent_activity.title: Nordic has bought in this sub-sector at both small and very large sizes
precedent_activity.body: Its four Core Healthcare Services deals span $26M to $1,304M [T:record]. Green Medical Center (2022) was a $1,304M LBO at 15.0x EBITDA [D:MA-2022-0045]. Harbor Medical Center (2023) was a $991M LBO at 11.1x [D:MA-2023-0466]. Harbor Health Network (2024) was a $35M carve-out at 11.6x [D:MA-2024-0339]. Pioneer Ambulatory Care (2016) was a $26M platform investment at 9.1x [D:MA-2016-0469]. Only 8 of its 24 deals sit in the $100M-$400M band [K:size_band]. It has 2 deals in the Midwest [T:record].

valuation_context.title: Price at the 75th percentile, 15.3x, is defensible; Nordic's own median is lower at 12.5x
valuation_context.body: The 70 comparable deals show 10.7x at the lower quartile, 12.8x at the median and 15.3x at the 75th percentile [V:comps]. The target's 16.8% margin beats the comps' 12.9% median and sits above 87% of comps, which supports the 75th percentile [V:comps]. Nordic's median paid is 12.5x, but it paid 15.9x for Principal Physician Group and 15.0x for Green Medical Center [V:comps, D:MA-2024-0431, D:MA-2022-0045]. At 5.0x leverage and 8.5% interest, the equity cheque is $128M and IRR at ask is 18.7% against a 20% target [V:lbo]. Maximum price is $193M on the same exit and $216M on a platform exit at 15.0x [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Size stretch
risk_flags.concern: Nordic's median deal is $77M, under half the target's $200M EV.
risk_flags.mitigant: It has done much larger Core deals, at $991M and $1,304M, and the target is not smaller than its usual range.
risk_flags.reality: Only 8 of 24 deals fall in the $100M-$400M band, so $200M is not its usual size [T:record, K:size_band, S:not_smaller, D:MA-2023-0466, D:MA-2022-0045].

risk_flags.title: Price gap to ask
risk_flags.concern: IRR at ask is 18.7%, below the 20% target, and the same-exit maximum price is $193M.
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts maximum price to $216M, above the $200M EV.
risk_flags.reality: Nordic can only meet the ask by underwriting the add-on route to the platform exit multiple [V:lbo, A:angles].

risk_flags.title: Competitive process and geography
risk_flags.concern: Welsh Carson and Advent also hold open platforms, and Advocate Health is a Core strategic buyer with a Midwest deal.
risk_flags.mitigant: Nordic has 2 Midwest deals, including one in 2024.
risk_flags.reality: The geography signal still counts against it at x0.95, and its likelihood is 4.8% among 107 buyers scored [S:geo_fit, T:record, D:MA-2024-0431, R:rank].

conviction.rationale: The basis is 4 deals in the target's own sub-sector, 18 in Ring 1, an open platform for the add-on route and Tier 1 position 2 [C:conviction, R:rank]. The main offset is that its $77M median deal is under half the $200M EV [C:conviction, T:record].
